# lean-pkg blueprint

blueprint: check (\\lean{} names with checkdecls).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg blueprint [--json] [COMMAND]
```

## Subcommands

- [`lean-pkg blueprint check`](blueprint-check.md): run checkdecls on the blueprint's declaration list at HEAD and check claims.yaml against it; exit 0 nothing missing / 1; writes nothing

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).
